description: Dependency update policy. Every version in this repository is pinned exactly; Renovate proposes updates as pull requests and a maintainer merges them by hand.
No update is merged automatically (repository rule), every update waits seven days after its release, and updates without a verifiable release date are held.

customManagers.description: Versions annotated with '# renovate: datasource=<datasource> depName=<name> [packageName=<name>] [versioning=<scheme>]' on the line above a variable or key. The value is a version, optionally followed by @sha256:<digest>. Every shell script is scanned, because only annotated lines match.

Commits that track a branch: '# renovate: datasource=<datasource> depName=<name> [packageName=<name>] [versioning=<scheme>] currentValue=<branch>' above a variable or key that holds the commit SHA or image digest.
kindest/node images in kind/node-images.yaml, pinned by tag and digest. One entry per Kubernetes minor.
kind release that built the node images listed in kind/node-images.yaml.
RKE2 release of each cluster (rke2.version in clusters/<cluster>/cluster.yaml), for example v1.36.6+rke2r1.
Python packages pinned inside mise tool options, for example with = ["ansible-core==2.22.0"].

packageRules.description: Pinning freezes the version already in use, so there is no new release to age.
These registries publish no release timestamps, so Renovate holds their updates as pending in the Dependency Dashboard. A maintainer requests one there after checking the upstream release date.
prBodyNotes: This registry does not publish release timestamps, so the 7-day minimum release age could not be checked automatically. Confirm the upstream release date before merging.

packageRules.description: Major updates are raised only after approval in the Dependency Dashboard.
A Kubernetes minor version is a platform upgrade (version skew, API removals), so it is treated like a major update.
Environment values change only through promotion pull requests from the release workflow, never through Renovate.
kubectl is published from the kubernetes/kubernetes repository; the aqua package path is not a GitHub repository.
Group GitHub Actions minor, patch and digest updates into one pull request.
Kubernetes tooling moves together: kind, its node images and kubectl.
prBodyNotes: kindest/node images are built for one kind release. Check that every digest in kind/node-images.yaml matches the release notes of the kind version in this pull request.

packageRules.description: Each kindest/node entry stays on its Kubernetes minor; adding or dropping a minor is a manual change.
The Kyverno CLI used by make policy-test follows the Kyverno version that the chart deploys.
prBodyNotes: Keep the Kyverno CLI (mise.toml) on the application version that this chart version deploys.

packageRules.description: gateway-crds-helm and gateway-helm are released together and must stay on the same version.
ansible-core and the tools built on it are pinned in mise.toml and ansible/requirements-dev.txt and move together.
Wrapper charts repeat the upstream version in appVersion, the chart README and the generated support matrix.
prBodyNotes: Update appVersion in the wrapper Chart.yaml and the version table in the chart README, then run make support-matrix and commit docs/reference/support-matrix.md.

packageRules.description: The devcontainer installs mise from a pinned release with fixed checksums that Renovate cannot update.
prBodyNotes: Also update the mise version and both SHA-256 checksums in the onCreateCommand of .devcontainer/devcontainer.json, from SHASUMS256.txt of the same release.

packageRules.description: Trivy pins need a manual check of the signed release checksums before merge.
prBodyNotes: Security review required before merge: verify the cosign signature of the release checksums file against the aquasecurity/trivy release workflow identity, confirm the version is not affected by a known supply-chain advisory (for example GHSA-69fq-xp46-6x23), and record the check in the review. CI passing is not sufficient.

packageRules.description: Repository rule: nothing is merged automatically, whatever a preset or an earlier rule sets.
